comparison_readiness: A single-case numerical screen; targeted mesh/time-step comparison and warning review remain necessary.
region_definition: Initial element centroid: body part 1, pad roots 0.112<=abs(X)<=0.150 m; body remainder excludes roots. Cap separately part 2. Stress tensor averaged across integration points, then von Mises; volume-weighted percentiles.

constraints.note: Check rigid-material CON1/CON2 and internal constraints as well as these explicit SPCs.

spc.note: Fixed foam backing reactions are expected. Only guide node records enter the guide axial check; rigid-material restraints may not appear in SPCFORC.

foam_jacobians.scope: All saved states, all eight Gauss points; unsaved cycles are not checked.
